title: Introductory Organic Chemistry I
modules: Bonding, Functional Groups, Classification And Nomenclature
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used as a tool in structure determination."
Oxidative cleavage reactions are used as a tool in structure determination.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a linear molecule having cylindrically symmetrical π electron density about the internuclear axis."
Acetylene is a linear molecule having cylindrically symmetrical π electron density about the internuclear axis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called diolefins or alkadienes or dienes."
Hydrocarbons containing two double bonds are called diolefins or alkadienes or dienes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to separate the two numbers and the numbers are separated from names of groups by a hyphen."
Note that a comma is used to separate the two numbers and the numbers are separated from names of groups by a hyphen.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a' reaction which yields predominantly one isomer."
Stereoselective reaction is a' reaction which yields predominantly one isomer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the average distance between the nuclei of the atoms which are covalently bound together."
Bond length can be defined as the average distance between the nuclei of the atoms which are covalently bound together.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a cleavage reaction, i.e a reaction in which the double bond is completely broken and alkene molecule is converted into two smaller molecules."
Ozonolysis is a cleavage reaction, i.e a reaction in which the double bond is completely broken and alkene molecule is converted into two smaller molecules.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are composed of positively and negatively charged ions which are held together by electrostatic forces."
Ionic compounds are composed of positively and negatively charged ions which are held together by electrostatic forces.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as an atom or a group of atoms in a molecule which exhibits characteristic chemical properties."
A functional group can be defined as an atom or a group of atoms in a molecule which exhibits characteristic chemical properties.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the distinguishing feature of the monoenes and dienes."
Carbon-carbon double bond is the distinguishing feature of the monoenes and dienes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called alkynes and will be dealt with in detail in Unit 5 of module 2."
Compounds having triple bond are called alkynes and will be dealt with in detail in Unit 5 of module 2.
fib: ______ are derived by using the suffix one instead of final e of the parent hydrocarbon.
IUPAC names for ketones
The IUPAC names for ketones are derived by using the suffix one instead of final e of the parent hydrocarbon.
______ can be defined as the angle between the atoms, forming the bonds to the same atom.
Bond angle
Bond angle can be defined as the angle between the atoms, forming the bonds to the same atom.
______ are used to define octane numbers between 0 and 100.
Mixtures of these two compounds
Mixtures of these two compounds are used to define octane numbers between 0 and 100.
______ are the compounds that have identical molecular formulas but differ in the ways in which the atoms are bonded to each other.
Isomers
Isomers are the compounds that have identical molecular formulas but differ in the ways in which the atoms are bonded to each other.
______ are the most important among the dienes.
conjugated dienes
The conjugated dienes are the most important among the dienes.
______ is the continuous assessment component of your course.
TMA
Tutor-Marked Assignment The TMA is the continuous assessment component of your course.
______ is the reaction of 1, 3-butadiene with ethane to yield cyclohexene.
simplest Diels-Alder reaction
The simplest Diels-Alder reaction is the reaction of 1, 3-butadiene with ethane to yield cyclohexene.
______ is an oily, thick inflammable and usually dark coloured liquid.
Petroleum
Petroleum is an oily, thick inflammable and usually dark coloured liquid.
______ is an intermediate and can be isolated using proper reaction conditions.
dihaloalkene
A dihaloalkene is an intermediate and can be isolated using proper reaction conditions.
______ are a group of relatively inactive compounds whose general formula is Cn H 2n+2.
alkanes
The alkanes are a group of relatively inactive compounds whose general formula is Cn H 2n+2.
